title: Not as sharp as expected…
text: Not as sharp as expected…. I guess you get what you pay for. Poorly packaged and not very sharp… I returned this item. The knives were pretty!

product_metadata.title: ZWILLING Steak Knife Set, 4 pc, black
features: 4-1/2-inch serrated blades slice steaks, chops, roasts
Made of high-carbon stainless steel with synthetic handles
description: The ZWILLING TWIN Gourment Classic line features precision steel and a single piece stamped construction. ZWILLING Special Formula, high carbon no-stain steel blades are FRIODUR ice-hardened to be durable, stay sharp, and not rust. Classic Triple Riveted Handle for comfort, durability and strength. Made in Spain..

From one of Henckels' moderately priced cutlery lines, these four steak knives will divide any rib-eye, chop, or roast into bite-size pieces. The thin, curved blades are perfect for precise cutting, though their fine serrations tend to tear meat fibers rather than slice neatly through them. Stamped from high-carbon stainless steel, these knives are lighter in weight than forged knives and don't have bolsters, which might not be essential when confronting a thick prime rib. The synthetic handles feature classic three-rivet styling with full tangs for strength. The knives are dishwasher-safe and they carry a lifetime warranty against defects.
